Shyam President RV Educational Institutions (RVEI) has upheld a legacy of academic merit and societal commitment for over eight decades. With a strong presence in Bengaluru, it continues to empower students through accessible education across disciplines.At the heart of this vision stands SSMRV College (SSMRV) – an institution dedicated to holistic education since 1984. Built on the foundation of 360-degree Education for Wholeness, the college blends academic rigour with real-world relevance, offering programmes in disciplines like commerce, computer applications and beyond.The college takes pride in nurturing socially responsible, industry-ready graduates equipped with the knowledge, skills and values to succeed in a competitive world. Through experienced faculty, state-of-the-art infrastructure and a strong culture of innovation, SSMRV continues to shape the thinkers, professionals and changemakers of tomorrow.
